steps.text: Eno, what's this book about?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Ah, I read it. So I brought it for you.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I think you'll like it, Sasha! It's a book about ideals.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Ideals?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: What are your ideals, Eno?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...Ideals, huh.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I don't know. Can I have ideals?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Of course you can! Why couldn't you?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Ah, crap, it's time to go home...

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: You don't want to go?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...I don't want to go home.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: But Eno, you said that if you didn't go home, your father would beat you...

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: But I'll see you tomorrow, right? I can still see you tomorrow.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I know. I'll put the book and some bread in here.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...Sasha, I don't want to go. It's terrible. I'll get beaten even if I go back now.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: So come out tomorrow. If you get hit, you can hit me.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Huh...? Hahaha, Sasha, did you get in another fight? Did they knock your head around?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: You have bruises, so many wounds.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: This way, people know you're hurting. At least someone will know.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Well, I know what you're thinking. But I won't.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: If those kids are still picking on you, let me know! I'll take them all down!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: See you tomorrow! I'll come and sing to you again!
I don't even know what happened to him.
All I know is that he gave me food.
I only know that he could read, and I wanted to read, and he taught me.
I only know that the other kids liked to bully him because he gave me bread and I was stronger, and I hit them and they hit me.
But I don't know what happened to him.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I'm scared. Sasha, I'm really scared.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I think.... I don't belong in that home. I overheard that my mom.... My mom isn't even in the house.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: The way they look at me, they're all terrifying, and I don't want to go back. I don't want to go back....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: But there's no food, or anywhere to stay here, it's just.... Just sewers.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: But....

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Do you hate me too?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: What...? Why?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Because I like to laugh?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: No.... No. Why would I?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Because I shouldn't laugh.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Nonsense! Eno, you should keep laughing.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Really.
Would things be different if he didn't go back that day?
Just because I thought my place was too cold and dirty, I sent him home?
If he hadn't gone back, would it have changed everything?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: You're hurt! The wound on your stomach.... What happened, what happened?!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Sasha.... I've been laughing.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: You see, you told me I could laugh, so I kept laughing.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I never stopped laughing....

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Sasha, do you still want to hear me sing?
After that, he visited me from time to time.
And each time he had more and more scars....
So many more.
I realized how much the things I said influenced him. So I started talking less.
Would that make things better?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Your back!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Your back....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: ......Does it hurt?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: This can't keep happening.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Who the hell did this?! Why are they doing this to you?!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Whoever it is.... they need to be punished! Whatever it is, it needs to be destroyed!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Eno, take me with you!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...All right.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I will.
I didn't know what I'd said.
I didn't know if I could say anything anymore.
What did I do? What the hell did I do?
I've read a lot of books too, but no book ever told me.
Nothing ever told me.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Look. Look at it, Sasha...

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: You told me you wanted to destroy everything that hurt me, didn't you?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Come on.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Your wounds...

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: They're not important. It doesn't matter.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: You see, with one little breath.... It's all better. It's all fine.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Come on, I'll bandage you up! There must be some cloth around here...!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: That man cut my leg.... Then with one breath, it's better.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: An old man slashed my back. One light touch, and it was fine.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: And it's all thanks to that Originium rock that fat woman shoved down my throat!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: That's enough, Eno. Really...

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I can't sing anymore, but you see, it's all from the Originium!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: There's nothing I can't do!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Eno!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...You're unhappy. Why? I only did what you told me.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Why are you unhappy?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Obviously they're all happy. Just do what they say and they'll all be happy....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: ...Because all of your family are assholes. All of them.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: So the kids killed them.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: The Infected kids who hadn't been driven out of town....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: What did you do to them?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: They hit me, too. They hurt you too.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Now, they are like pieces on a chess board. My literal pawns.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: As soon as I healed their wounds, they obeyed my every command.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I'll take that bunch of ugly, disgusting people, all of them.... All of them!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: You see, Sasha? You see what I've done?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: We'll burn it down in one magnificent blaze! All of it!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Sasha, what's wrong with you?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Don't do anything like that ever again.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: But I thought you said....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: I didn't think it would turn out this way.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Eno, do what you really want to do. Not this.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: I can help you. You don't have to do this.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: But I....

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: That's enough! Just do what you truly want, Eno!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Not what you're forced to do. Not the bloodshed, not the heartbreak, not the revenge!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: You don't even like this kind of thing...!

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: ...Sasha...

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I want to.... Sing....

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Ugh....
I couldn't do anything.
I was useless.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Eno....

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: I can't sing anymore.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: We'll go together. We'll survive.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Survive?

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: What's so great about that?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: But we can do it together.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: What are you going to do?

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: This is the Originium I stole from the mine, I was going to sell it for some food.

steps.name: Eno
steps.text: Sasha!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Mmm!

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: This way, we're both infected.

steps.name: Sasha
steps.text: Let's survive together.
Such things? I'm not interested.
There is no reason for anything you do. There is no meaning to your life on this planet.
No, you don't need anyone to save you...
Pick a name you like.
This one? Good.
Mephisto...
Mephisto. From now on, you are Mephisto. You are no longer what you were.
I don't trust you. I have no right to trust you. The only person you can trust is yourself.
What you did cannot be written off. You will always carry your past, even if you forget, even if you cannot understand what you did.
Everything you do, everything you go through, will become your kindling. They compel you, to keep the fire burning within you....
Until the whole earth is free, until you throw away all that others have given you, until you finally understand yourself.
At that point, you can even discard the name. It's your choice whether you stay or go, live or die.
Mephisto, I can't change your ideals. If you don't have it, go find it. We'll help ourselves.
Who am I? That's not important.
What should you call me?
......Talulah

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm a rebel, an ordinary woman. I'm nobody. But for now, you can call me Talulah
And Talulah didn't say much to me.
She held me tight and rapped three times on my back.
Talulah trusted me. Yelena, Buldrokkas'tee, Lyudmila. They all believed in me.
I thought I could put the childhood I spent in that city behind me.
Only, things changed quickly. It started with what happened in that village.
It was a tragedy. But why did that tragedy make her this way?
Why did things turn out like this?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I'll do whatever you want me to do....

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No need. Do as you please.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I allow it. You are Mephisto, after all.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But, you said before....

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That was years ago.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's only natural that some things change over the course of a career.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If we don't keep up with the times, we're doomed.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So we, and our fellow Infected, must fight for our collective future.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Anyone can be sacrificed for that ideal.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I can trust you, can't I?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes. Because I am Talulah.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Then I will!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You will, I'm sure you will.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We can't do it without you. You can do anything, and you can accomplish anything.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You should have seen it all.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I am Talulah, of course.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: The Talulah I knew... is not you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Talulah is just a name. Talulah is just Talulah

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Help him. Mephisto needs your help. Mephisto needs you to give him value. He trusts only you and me.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Talulah would never do that. You're taking advantage of his trust in you!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: None of us have the power to choose.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You'll do it for him. Everything.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Or would you rather watch him die?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Don't you realize what happened? After passing through that village, Talulah changed completely! She's not the same person!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Then why are you doing this?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I don't trust anyone but you and her.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: And I don't want to choose.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, where are we going?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Faust, tell me. What should we do?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ......We survive.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Isn't it painful to be alive?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: It's painful.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: But we can do it together.
This book, it's a book about ideals.
My ideals are....
